page.layout: One page of text within an ornamental woodcut border; page number and running head at the top of the text block; no notes in the margins; catchword "Univer-" continues below the last line as a hyphenated word at the right.

main_text.p: ras & Lapides minerales, quos fuse hactenus percensuimus distincte recenset: interim tamen pag. 244. Currus sui triumphalis aperte simul profitetur, Sex hos Lapides metallicarum Tincturarum omnes ex uno semine, & una initiali matre, quam videlicet omnes in sua generatione prima (verba sunt ipsius Basilii) acceperint, ita proseminari, ut ex eadem verum Universale consimiliter profluxerit, luce meridiana clarius liquet, praeter & supra essentiam aurificam tum vulgaris, tum Philosophici auri nostri (ex vulgari enim Tinctura Veneris & Martis imbuenda est: ex Philosophico vero potissimum nostro Tinctura Solis constat) adhuc aliud esse, idq; longe magis adhuc abditum, ex quo Universale Univer-

page.notes: Long s rendered as s; the reading "ver-" at the foot is the catchword-like continuation of the last line. Some words in the italic passage are uncertain in the scan, notably "Tincturarum" and "proseminari", which were read as printed. The marginal ornament carries no text.
